columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: The timestamp (in UTC) when the log entry was generated.

columns.name: ApiType
columns.description: Indicates the API type, for example Soap Enterprise.

columns.name: ApiVersion
columns.description: Displays the API version used by the client.

columns.name: Application
columns.description: The application used to access the organization.

columns.name: AuthMethodReference
columns.description: The authentication method used by a third-party identification provider for an OpenID Connect single sign-on protocol.

columns.name: AuthenticationServiceId
columns.description: The 18-character ID for an authentication service for a login event.

columns.name: Browser
columns.description: The current browser version.

columns.name: CipherSuite
columns.description: The TLS cipher suite used for the login.

columns.name: ClientVersion
columns.description: Version of the API client.

columns.name: CountryIso
columns.description: The ISO 3166 code for the country where the user's IP address is physically located.

columns.name: ForwardedForIp
columns.description: The value in the X-Forwarded-For header of HTTP requests sent by the client.

columns.name: LoginGeoId
columns.description: The 18-character ID for the record of the geographic location of the user for a successful or unsuccessful login event.

columns.name: LoginSubType
columns.description: The type of login flow used.

columns.name: LoginTime
columns.description: Time zone is based on GMT.

columns.name: LoginType
columns.description: The type of login used to access the session.

columns.name: LoginUrl
columns.description: URL from which the login request is coming.

columns.name: NetworkId
columns.description: The ID of the Experience Cloud site that the user is logging in to.

columns.name: OptionsIsGet
columns.description: The HTTP method used for the session login is a GET request.

columns.name: OptionsIsPost
columns.description: The HTTP method used for the session login is a POST request.

columns.name: Platform
columns.description: Operating system on the login machine.

columns.name: SourceIp
columns.description: The IP address of the incoming client request that first reaches Salesforce during a login.

columns.name: Status
columns.description: Displays the status of the attempted login. Status is either success or a reason for failure.

columns.name: TlsProtocol
columns.description: The TLS protocol used for the login.

columns.name: UserId
columns.description: ID of the user logging in.

columns.name: SalesforceDomain
columns.description: Salesforce host/domain configured for this connection; hard-coded on every record so hosts can be differentiated.
